title: Chapter 331 Zhao Bangde'S Back-Up Plan
content:
Chapter 331 Zhao Bangde'S Back-Up Plan

"Lord, this is for you."

Gong Zheng released his transformation, took the water of life, and returned the resurrection coin in his hand to Wang Shuo.

Wang Shuo took a look and put the resurrection coin away.

Compared to Gong Zheng, he seemed to be more likely to die and lacked means to save his life.

At this time, under the city wall, the skeleton warriors surged up again.

The city wall was blown up into a staircase, and the skeleton warriors could already climb up along the collapsed city wall.

Fortunately, the number of skeleton warriors was reduced by more than half compared to before.

This explosion alone killed thousands of them.

Wang Shuo looked around at everyone and said in a deep voice: "Hurry up, replenish your status and prepare for battle."

Seeing that Sauron was still fighting hard, Wang Shuo immediately rushed forward with his core generals to help.

With the two top generals Ayub and Gong Zheng, the top combat power of the East Gate has changed.

Especially the fall of the Thunder Skeleton King, which led to a reversal of the situation.

Soon, the other two undead warriors at the east gate were killed by everyone.

This time, Wang Shuo was quick and grabbed a trophy.

It was a token. Wang Shuo had not had time to take a closer look when something strange happened.

After seeing that most of the undead warriors had entered Shanhai City, Zhao Bangde shouted: "Launch the 'Undead Soul-Destroying' formation."

As soon as he finished speaking.

In the city lord's mansion, hundreds of people wearing sacrificial robes sat cross-legged in a certain direction.

In the middle of the priests, there was a small tower made of soul crystals.

It was really too luxurious.

They kept muttering spells and turning magic tools in their hands.

In an instant, white streams of light spread from the central tower along the ground.

After a few breaths, the entire Shanhai City, with the city wall as the boundary, rose with countless purifying lights.

Within the envelopment of the formation, the dead air in the bodies of the undead was constantly extracted from their bodies and purified.

The army of undead fell into collective wailing.

Wang Shuo was shocked to see this change.

Sure enough, Zhao Bangde had a backup plan.

Ordinary undead were directly purified into a pile of bones by the purifying light all over the city.

The elite undead warriors resisted for a longer time.

But their strength was constantly weakened under the purification.

Just when Wang Shuo thought everything was settled.

The purifying light disappeared all of a sudden.

This--

It feels like being out of pants, the police are here, and the thief is uncomfortable!

It turned out that the hundreds of priests in the lord's mansion had fainted.

The consumption of this formation was too great, and they could not maintain it for too long.

Wang Shuo finally figured it out. Before, Zhao Bangde should have wanted to bring more undead into the city so that he could catch them all in one fell swoop.

Although there were still about one-fifth of the undead warriors who had not entered Shanhai City, the human soldiers were almost unable to hold on, so he had to activate this formation.

Affected by this, the number of undead in Shanhai City was reduced by half in just a few breaths.

The remaining ones, although they were all elites of the Burning Legion, had at least reduced their strength by nearly half.

For a time, the morale of the human race was greatly shaken.

The undead were killed and retreated step by step.

General Arif Ubol, looking at this situation, hesitated in his heart.

At this time, should he rush in?

What if the cunning Zhao Bangde still had a backhand to deal with him specifically?

This desperate rush forward, wouldn't it be a trap?

But if he didn't push all the remaining troops forward and lead the charge into the city.

This battle, I'm afraid he will lose!

He was a little embarrassed.

At this time, Zhao Bangde came to the East Gate Tower again, looking at Arif Ubol from a distance, with a faint smile on his lips.

Wang Shuo noticed Zhao Bangde's expression again.

There were doubts in my heart.

I didn't expect that Zhao Bangde was really a fool.
